claim: The final SMB v2 run reconciles 1152 unique tuples, 384 degradation traces, 64 document-group IDs, six conditions and three methods.
scope_limitations: Applies only to the fresh measurable-staff-scale SMB v2 sample; v1 is development/stress evidence. DEV-SCI-02: IDs remove only the page suffix and do not certify independent complete compositions; see docs/unit-of-analysis-audit.md. Original numerical reconciliation: 2026-08-31; current review changes interpretation only.

claim: EDSR and SwinIR improve both primary fidelity metrics over bicubic in all six conditions at document-group paired 95 percent intervals.
scope_limitations: Statistical separation does not establish practical relevance, musical correctness, real-scan transfer or population prevalence. DEV-SCI-02: intervals are conditional on independent document groups; residual movement/edition dependence may affect precision and is not ruled out by correct recomputation. Original numerical reconciliation: 2026-08-31; see docs/unit-of-analysis-audit.md.

claim: SwinIR leads EDSR on both primary metrics in x2-clean, x2-moderate and x4-clean, but EDSR is favored on at least SSIM-Y in the three remaining conditions.
scope_limitations: Two PSNR comparisons cross zero; method preference is conditional and tied to the retained runtime and qualitative evidence. DEV-SCI-02: the document-group bootstrap does not certify complete-composition independence; residual movement/edition dependence may affect interval precision. Original numerical reconciliation: 2026-08-31; see docs/unit-of-analysis-audit.md.

claim: The fixed qualitative cases contain altered symbols, text or digit corruption, and natural-image texture even when aggregate fidelity improves.
scope_limitations: Six outcome-independent pages and 18 assessments are descriptive cases, not defect prevalence or a blinded specialist study.

claim: EDSR is the default fidelity-cost option for assisted visual enhancement; SwinIR is reserved for conditions where its paired gain justifies the extra runtime.
scope_limitations: The original must be retained and outputs human-verified; no semantic restoration, OMR, archival replacement or autonomous publication claim is supported.

claim: The bounded EDSR adaptation run reconciles 360 unique tuples, 24 paired bootstrap rows, 30 fixed qualitative PNGs, two checkpoints and document-ID-disjoint 45/13/20 project roles.
scope_limitations: Roles are project-defined inside SMB's official test split; the primary 64 document-group IDs are excluded. DEV-SCI-02: related movements can cross roles despite zero identical page/ID overlap; no complete-composition separation is certified. Original numerical reconciliation: 2026-09-01; see docs/unit-of-analysis-audit.md.

claim: SMB-adapted EDSR improves PSNR-Y and SSIM-Y over the official pretrained EDSR in all six conditions at document-group paired 95 percent intervals.
scope_limitations: Twenty test document groups; matched synthetic degradations and within-SMB adaptation only; no musical-correctness, real-scan, other-corpus or deployment claim. DEV-SCI-02: intervals assume independent groups; residual movement/edition dependence may affect precision and unseen-composition generalization is not established. Original numerical reconciliation: 2026-09-01; see docs/unit-of-analysis-audit.md.

claim: The fixed student review classifies four of six adapted EDSR cases as improvement without a clear new defect and two strong cases as LR damage not recovered; no case is classified as introduced or amplified damage.
scope_limitations: Six descriptive cases do not estimate prevalence or semantic correctness; the strong cases retain losses in small symbols, text, digits and fine geometry.

claim: The clean local external run reconciles 216 unique outputs, 24 paired bootstrap rows, 60 fixed review images and twelve reviewed independent works.
scope_limitations: The raw corpus and unselected derivatives remain outside Git; the thesis includes selected attributed analytical comparisons under docs/professional-pilot-publication-basis.md. The run changes collection but retains synthetic LR and the frozen matched degradation generator. DEV-SCI-02 concerns SMB grouping and does not change these twelve external works. Original numerical reconciliation: 2026-09-03; current review corrects publication scope only.

claim: Adapted EDSR has positive mean PSNR-Y and SSIM-Y deltas over official EDSR in all six external conditions; all PSNR-Y and five of six SSIM-Y source-bootstrap intervals exclude zero.
scope_limitations: Twelve external band-score works under matched synthetic LR; this does not establish naturally acquired LR restoration, semantic correctness or universal transfer.

claim: The fixed student review accepts eight derivatives for consultation, accepts three with reservations and rejects one; five have no clear new defect and seven retain unrecovered LR damage.
scope_limitations: Twelve input-selected cases, two per condition, one unblinded reviewer and no specialist panel; counts are descriptive. All twelve predeclared pages are embedded only as attributed analytical figures under the later bounded publication record; the corpus is not released.

claim: The image-only local demonstrator preserves the original, supports explicit x2/x4 inference, exposes model and output identity, and returns a reversible PNG derivative with bounded inputs.
scope_limitations: Implemented and automated-test validated locally; PDF, accounts, persistent history, public deployment, multi-user security and formal usability are not claimed.

claim: Twenty-one thesis figures expose score structure, matched degradation severity, pretrained outputs, adaptation improvement, retained failures, and complete-page behaviour using only predeclared qualitative cases.
scope_limitations: Eight analytical-crop figures including three detail galleries and thirteen attributed full-page comparisons are embedded for critical academic analysis; the twelve external pages cover every fixed decision. They are descriptive, do not estimate defect prevalence, and do not release either corpus.
